project_type: Local 'Brawl Hockey' tournament dashboard: Python stdlib HTTP server + pure-Python rules engine + vanilla JS single-file frontend. No third-party runtime deps.
language: Python 3 (stdlib only) and vanilla browser JavaScript/HTML/CSS
build_system: None. Run directly with python3 app.py. No package manager, no bundler.
test_framework: Python unittest (tests/*.py, run via discover) + a headless Node VM harness (tests/test_ui.cjs) that loads static/app.js into a fake-DOM context and asserts rendered HTML/handlers. An optional Playwright test tests/test_browser.cjs exists but is NOT runnable here (Playwright is not installed) and references UI features that are irrelevant/partly stale; it is not part of the green baseline.
build_command: No build. Syntax check JS with: node --check static/app.js
test_command: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests  (44 tests, must stay green)  AND  node tests/test_ui.cjs (must exit 0)
verification_instructions:
1) python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -> OK, 44 tests. 2) node tests/test_ui.cjs -> prints pass lines, exit 0. 3) node --check static/app.js -> no syntax error. 4) Live probe via a script FILE under /projects/sandbox (NOT inline port/host flags, which trip a server-start guard, and each bash call is a fresh PID namespace): start `python3 app.py --no-browser --port

--data /tmp/t.json` in background, curl /, /app.js, PUT an old-style backup containing a populated wheel object to /api/state with restore:true and assert 200, GET /api/backup, then kill — all in ONE shell invocation.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. tournament.json is gitignored runtime data. round1 lineups are generated lazily by engine.round1_lineups and persisted into the data file; not a source artifact.
setup_instructions: No setup. Python 3 and Node are preinstalled. Just run the test/verify commands above from the repo root /projects/sandbox/Autosurveryai.
environment_constraints: No external network needed and none assumed. Playwright/Chromium is NOT installed, so tests/test_browser.cjs cannot run and must not be relied on. Server-start guard: do NOT type literal --port/--host/127.0.0.1 flags directly in an execute_bash command string; put the server launch inside a script file under /projects/sandbox and run start+curl+kill in a single bash invocation (each call gets a fresh PID namespace).
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md. Branch feat/remove-name-wheel is already created off main (HEAD ec1b309). Do NOT push or open a PR. Commit changes to the working tree only. No em dashes in prose/comments.
key_patterns: static/app.js is one file. The six rooms/tabs are declared at top: const tabs=[['wheel','Name wheel'],['settings',...],...]. renderRoom() builds the room grid from a local `config` array (first entry is the wheel tile with .wheel-mini art). The content dispatcher in render() is: tab==='overview'?overview():...:tab==='wheel'?wheelPage():round(tab). CRITICAL SHARED-SCREEN FACT: the 'wheel' screen is used in TWO modes via the global `wheelMode`. wheelMode==='free' renders wheelPage() = the standalone 'Name your fate' Name wheel (DELETE). wheelMode==='round2' renders sitoutWheelPage() = the To Die sit-out draw (MUST KEEP WORKING). The To Die flow reaches it via the click action 'r2-wheel' (sets wheelMode='round2'; openScreen('wheel')) and via progressRound2() which sets tab='wheel';wheelMode='round2' and animates the sit-out pair. So removing the Name wheel must NOT simply delete the 'wheel' screen; the sit-out draw rendering it depends on (sitoutWheelPage, sitoutCandidates, animateSitoutPair, drawWheel, the #wheel-canvas created inside sitoutWheelPage, globals wheelAngle/spinning/sitoutBusy/sitoutAnimating) must be preserved and still reachable. engine.py keeps a `wheel` field in new_state() and validate() purely for backward-compat; the UI must stop surfacing it but the schema must keep accepting it (schema version stays 4, no migration bump).
relevant_files: static/app.js (all wheel logic + the shared sit-out draw; main edit target)
static/index.html (monitors grid container #monitors is JS-rendered; no static #wheel-canvas, but check head/meta copy)

static/style.css (wheel-only selectors: .wheel-mini and .monitor-wheel tile art; shared-with-sit-out selectors: .wheel-layout/.wheel-stage/.wheel-wrap/.wheel-hub/.wheel-result/.draw-help/.sitout-hub/.wheel-modes — keep those the sit-out draw still renders)
engine.py (KEEP the wheel block in new_state()/validate() for backward-compat; do not change schema version)
tests/test_ui.cjs (asserts sit-out draw via wheelMode='round2'; also has a block exercising wheelModeTabs and spinWheel as a plain name draw that must be reconciled)
tests/test_tournament.py (test_wheel_large_lists_migration_and_validation, test_legacy_round2_archive..., HTTP persistence test with wheel.text — all must stay green)
README.md (has a 'Name wheel' section, a 'Name your fate' bullet, and wheel mentions to update)
directory_structure: Repo root /projects/sandbox/Autosurveryai: app.py (HTTP server + Store), engine.py (rules), static/{index.html,app.js,style.css}, tests/{test_tournament.py,test_regressions.py,test_goal_limits.py,test_ui.cjs,test_browser.cjs}, README.md, tournament.json (gitignored runtime data), start.bat.
